steps.title: Stack at bosses
steps.rule: Depends on BossSpot: 3 → at 2; 1 → at 3; 7 → at 4; 5 → at 1.

OffTank.rule: Depends on BossSpot: 3 → near 2 (NE 9m); 1 → near 3 (SE 9m); 7 → near 4 (SW 9m); 5 → near 1 (NW 9m).

RegenHealer.rule: Depends on BossSpot: 3 → near 2 (NE 6m); 1 → near 3 (SE 6m); 7 → near 4 (SW 6m); 5 → near 1 (NW 6m).

ShieldHealer.rule: Depends on BossSpot: 3 → near 2 (NE 6m); 1 → near 3 (SE 6m); 7 → near 4 (SW 6m); 5 → near 1 (NW 6m).

MeleeDpsA.rule: Depends on BossSpot: 3 → near 2 (NE 7m); 1 → near 3 (SE 7m); 7 → near 4 (SW 7m); 5 → near 1 (NW 7m).

CasterDps.rule: Depends on BossSpot: 3 → near 2 (NE 7m); 1 → near 3 (SE 7m); 7 → near 4 (SW 7m); 5 → near 1 (NW 7m).

steps.title: Bait out
steps.rule: Depends on BossSpot: 3 → SW wall; 1 → NW wall; 7 → NE wall; 5 → SE wall.

steps.title: Tanks into stack
steps.rule: Depends on BossSpot: 3 → near 2 (NE 6m); 1 → near 3 (SE 6m); 7 → near 4 (SW 6m); 5 → near 1 (NW 6m).

steps.title: Bait back
steps.rule: Depends on BossSpot: 3 → at 2; 1 → at 3; 7 → at 4; 5 → at 1.

steps.title: Stack for cyclones
steps.rule: Depends on BossSpot: 3 → near 4 (SW 5m); 1 → near 1 (NW 5m); 7 → near 2 (NE 5m); 5 → near 3 (SE 5m).

MainTank.rule: Depends on BossSpot: 3 → SW 4m; 1 → NW 4m; 7 → NE 4m; 5 → SE 4m.

OffTank.rule: Depends on BossSpot: 3 → SW 4m; 1 → NW 4m; 7 → NE 4m; 5 → E 4m.

RegenHealer.rule: Depends on BossSpot: 3 → SW 4m; 1 → NW 4m; 7 → N 4m; 5 → E 4m.

PhysRangedDps.rule: Depends on BossSpot: 3 → near 4 (SW 6m); 1 → near 1 (NW 6m); 7 → near 2 (NE 6m); 5 → near 3 (SE 6m).

CasterDps.rule: Depends on BossSpot: 3 → near 4 (SW 6m); 1 → near 1 (NW 6m); 7 → near 2 (NE 6m); 5 → near 3 (SE 6m).

steps.title: Charge spots
steps.rule: Read the strat's ChargeSpots: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show (closest roll: BossSpot).

MainTank.rule: Read the strat's ChargeSpots: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show (closest roll: Winds has (OffTank,Tailwind)).

OffTank.rule: Read the strat's ChargeSpots: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show (closest roll: Clockwise).

ShieldHealer.rule: Read the strat's ChargeSpots: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show (closest roll: StartSpot).

MeleeDpsB.rule: Read the strat's ChargeSpots: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show (closest roll: Winds has (CasterDps,Headwind)).

PhysRangedDps.rule: Depends on Clockwise and Winds has (PhysRangedDps,Headwind): true & yes → N wall; false & no → NE wall; false & yes → N wall; true & no → E wall.

CasterDps.rule: Read the strat's ChargeSpots: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show (closest roll: StartSpot).

steps.title: Clear for thunder
steps.rule: Depends on BossSpot: 3 → near 4 (SW 6m); 1 → near 1 (NW 6m); 7 → near 2 (NE 6m); 5 → near 3 (SE 6m).

OffTank.rule: Depends on BossSpot: 3 → near 2 (NE 11m); 1 → near 3 (SE 11m); 7 → near 4 (SW 11m); 5 → near 1 (NW 11m).

RegenHealer.rule: Depends on BossSpot: 3 → SW 4m; 1 → NW 4m; 7 → NE 4m; 5 → SE 4m.

PhysRangedDps.rule: Depends on BossSpot: 3 → near 4 (SW 7m); 1 → near 1 (NW 7m); 7 → near 2 (NE 7m); 5 → near 3 (SE 7m).

CasterDps.rule: Depends on BossSpot: 3 → at 4; 1 → at 1; 7 → at 2; 5 → at 3.
